responsibility: Implements a dependency graph over module symbols and a depth-first ordering of imports according to ISO Modula-2 initialization rules. It creates graph nodes lazily, records dependency edges while skipping definition-for-C-only cases, resets per-node traversal state, recursively resolves imported modules into an ordered `List`, and ensures the requested top module is placed last in the final sorted order.
same_name_distinction: Implementation module for the M2Graph pair: it defines graph nodes, dependency-edge handling, traversal state, and the recursive import-order sort that keeps the top module last, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2Graph.def` only declares the abstract graph interface.
